concat_solver.method: in-place LU (scipy overwrite_a, the gesv family of the sealed solve) on the disk-spilled centred system built from the float32-rounded standardiser statistics; the section 6 amendment + correction; equivalence-gated in-run against the sealed solve path

anchors.note: fitting each half ALONE must reproduce its sealed full-data read at penalty 1.0 before the concatenation is trusted.

artifacts.note: both train matrices are the M141 cell-2 schedule (409,832 rows); row identity is PREMISE-CHECKED row by row (row count + labels digest + spot hash).

cell.note: the concatenation is SPM columns first, MS columns second, per row; row identity verified before any fit.

gate.registered: best concat cell (ridge read) >= best single construction + 0.005 at the disclosed feature-width cost (53627 cols); the trained-head read is the co-adaptation control (at 138k, the M146 r2 protocol); a cell failing both reads closes as a scoped negative (the v22 dual-read closure rule).
